meta.description: Portfolio of Vasu Garg, a Senior Full Stack Engineer with 4+ years building production web applications end-to-end across fintech, compliance, and security.

profile.name: Vasu Garg
profile.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
profile.tagline: I build fast, reliable, production-grade web apps — front to back.
profile.bio: Senior Full Stack Engineer with 4+ years shipping production web applications end-to-end across fintech, compliance, and security. I own the full lifecycle — from data models and REST/WebSocket APIs to state architecture and accessible UI.
profile.bio2: I care about scalable architecture, clean SOLID code, and interfaces that make complex, data-dense systems feel simple. Off the clock I'm exploring anime ⛩️ or games 🎮 and building side projects.

highlights: Shipped AI-powered, real-time interfaces — multi-thread chat with streaming LLM responses, an in-app strategy editor, and data-dense dashboards — now serving 500+ active users.
Drove ~1,000+ new signups in a single quarter by designing event-tracking schemas and wiring up Mixpanel, Meta Pixel, and Google Analytics to surface the insights that reshaped activation flows.
Cut application load time ~40% through code-splitting, lazy loading, and state-management optimization.
Built a resumable Python pipeline that migrated 50K+ documents across AWS S3 buckets with checkpoint-based restart — zero rework after interruptions.
Mentored 2 junior engineers on review practices and component design.
Owned full-stack delivery of a MERN admin platform end-to-end — REST APIs, MongoDB schemas, RBAC flows, and React UIs — partnering directly with product and compliance teams.
Shrank bundle size 35% (500 KB → 350 KB) by refactoring duplicated code into reusable components, measurably improving load times across products.
Hardened the API layer with JWT auth, request validation, and modular routing in Node/Express/TypeScript, built on SOLID principles and established design patterns.
Promoted to Senior Engineer after delivering Cove Drive — a zero-knowledge encrypted storage product — on clean OOP architecture.

projects.name: AI Trading Assistant (uAlgos)
projects.description: Delivered the frontend for an AI-powered, chat-based strategy builder — natural-language strategy creation with WebSocket-streamed LLM responses and a custom in-app IDE for editing AI-generated strategy artifacts.
highlights: Multi-thread chat with markdown→HTML streamed responses; cut strategy design time ~40%
Calendar-style backtest heatmap (max P/L, win/loss streaks) with trade-level breakdown
Set up CI/CD for the backend — automated test, build, and deploy jobs

projects.name: eKYC Multi-Vendor Platform
projects.description: Built a runtime JSON-configurable KYC platform with RBAC across 4 roles, securing review and approval workflows for 10,000+ submissions across 6+ B2B white-label clients.
highlights: RBAC dashboard (admin, agent, RM, affiliate) over 10,000+ KYC submissions
Digio + DigiLocker integration for Aadhaar/PAN, eSign, live selfie, and QR handoff — cut manual workload up to 60%
Responsive across devices; sped verification ~30% and lifted satisfaction

projects.name: Cove Drive — Encrypted Cloud Storage
projects.description: Built a zero-knowledge cloud storage product with hybrid AES + RSA encryption — files are encrypted client-side end-to-end, so the server never sees plaintext.
highlights: Hybrid AES (symmetric) + RSA (asymmetric) zero-knowledge model
Password-protected sharing and chunked, resumable multi-file uploads for unstable networks
Clean OOP/SOLID architecture — recognised internally and led to promotion to Senior

projects.name: Sekai
projects.description: Shipped a solo anime catalogue and tracker — browse trending/airing anime, search, and manage a personal watchlist. Live anime data via the AniList GraphQL API, persisted with Firestore and Firebase OAuth, and installable as a PWA.
highlights: Watchlist + tracking persisted in Firestore with Firebase auth
Redux Toolkit + TanStack Query for client and server-state caching
Installable PWA — works offline-friendly on desktop and mobile

projects.name: VasuGarg Labs
projects.description: Built a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo of 13+ independent React apps that share a common UI, auth, and utility layer through local workspace packages — each app builds and deploys to its own Firebase Hosting site.
highlights: Shared ui / shared / auth workspace packages with JWT (access + refresh) via axios interceptors
Formlyst — visual builder rendering multi-step forms at runtime from stored config; Pokeverse — virtualized Pokédex with turn-based battles
Turborepo-cached builds; per-app deploys to independent Firebase sites
